items.publisher: Exeter City Council via ArcGIS Online
items.evidence_slice: Exeter City Council's public ArcGIS Environment Planning FeatureServer, service item 383ec2af823b4695b02d9ae496add9e3, advertises layer 6 as 'Statutory Listed Buildings'. The service root is publicly readable without login, supports JSON queries, uses British National Grid EPSG:27700, and publishes an Exeter-area full extent. The exact layer-6 metadata URL could not be read through the available web channel, and a direct network request failed at DNS resolution before any layer definition or feature payload was returned. Therefore no geometry type, coordinates, record fields, building identity/type-use values, or individual statutory-listed-building feature were accepted; the inspected information is source-area metadata only.

field_evidence.footprint: Official service root advertises Statutory Listed Buildings layer 6, but exact layer/feature payload was not retrievable; physical footprint geometry is unverified.
field_evidence.type_use: No record-level building identity/type/use fields were readable from the blocked layer-6 payload.
field_evidence.heritage: Layer identity 'Statutory Listed Buildings' is explicitly advertised by the official Exeter City Council Environment Planning FeatureServer.
